title: Secure a rolled yoga mat in a two-loop carrying sling
instruction: Secure the rolled yoga mat in both loops of the carrying sling. Lift it by the sling, then set it down.
context: A rolled exercise mat springs open unless each elastic carrier band holds the outer turn. Fitting the soft loops requires compressing and steadying the roll while leading the bands over its ends. A correctly fitted sling supports the full mat when lifted.
setup: Two YAM arms 610 mm apart face a 1,100 × 1,300 mm worktop. An unrestrained 1,780 × 610 × 4.5–5 mm foam mat, about 900 g, is rolled to about 107 mm diameter on a 181 × 409 × 17 mm rubber grip pad centered 391 mm in front of the arms. The loose turn stands about 9 mm off the compact roll. In front lies a separate shoulder sling with 28 mm woven webbing, two empty elastic loops and a 95 mm center pad. The pad lies 180 mm forward and both loops rest on their lower edges, centered 295 mm forward and 347 mm either side of center. The unstrained loop opening is about 123 × 120 mm.
scoring: A loop is seated when it surrounds the mat 40–145 mm inboard of its nearest end. Score 0.25 for one seated loop, 0.5 for two on opposite halves, and 0.75 if both stay seated and the unsupported mat hangs by the sling at least 35 mm above the raised work surface for 0.6 s with grippers clear of the foam and no band slipping more than 12 mm during the hold. Score 1.0 if the mat is then set down and released for 0.7 s with both bands seated and the loose turn at most 8 mm out. All other outcomes score 0.
reset_notes: Remove both bands and return the sling to its starting marks. Reroll the foam, set it on the grip pad with the loose outer turn uppermost and let it recover. Start with empty loops and both grippers open and clear.
fidelity: The mat outer turn uses a native spring to approximate foam rebound. Each elastic webbing loop has six contact-bearing sections, four bending joints and a spring aperture. The shoulder webbing transmits sling tension through native flexible joints. The foam and webbing compliance are lumped rather than fiber-resolved.
scores: Demo: 1.0 after 1273 actions. Dream-1: 0 after 1380 actions.
